description.p: Loaf is a fast, expressive file manager for Linux built with Qt6 Quick and Rust. It features Material 3 Expressive design, tabs and split-pane view, background file operations with progress and undo, freedesktop trash integration, archive browsing and extraction, system drive management, and customizable theme palettes.
Loaf 0.3.0: WebDAV and unified network drives, XDG desktop portal file chooser, Devices sidebar with phone MTP support, modular settings overhaul, and major performance optimizations.
Loaf 0.2.0 release: settings modular overhaul, enhanced theme palette support, and stability improvements.
